Presentation Openings and Endings: German B1 Practice

Open and close a short presentation in German. Practise vorstellen, zunächst and audience questions with translated examples and explained B1 answers.

B1 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Useful phrases and patterns

An opening can name the topic and sequence: Ich möchte Ihnen … vorstellen; zunächst … . A closing can recap the main point and invite questions. Vielen Dank für Ihre Aufmerksamkeit thanks the audience. This speaker role differs from chairing a meeting or setting tasks for a team.

Common mistake to avoid

After möchte, keep vorstellen as an infinitive at the end of the clause. If zunächst starts a main clause, the conjugated verb normally comes next.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Pay attention to the exact article, verb position or ending described in the rule.

Worked example 1Ich möchte Ihnen heute unser kleines Leseprojekt vorstellen.Today I would like to introduce our small reading project to you.
Worked example 2Zunächst zeige ich Ihnen die Ausgangssituation.First I will show you the initial situation.
Worked example 3Zum Schluss fasse ich die wichtigsten Ergebnisse zusammen.At the end I will summarise the main findings.
Worked example 4Vielen Dank für Ihre Aufmerksamkeit; welche Fragen haben Sie?Thank you for your attention; what questions do you have?

Practice: complete the phrases

Complete the presentation frame with the infinitive, sequence word or audience noun specified by the cue. Use each word-bank item once. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Word bank: Aufmerksamkeit · Fragen · vorstellen · Zunächst

Question 1. Ich möchte Ihnen das Thema kurz ___. (introduce)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: vorstellen

Vorstellen is the infinitive after möchte.

Question 2. ___ erkläre ich die Ausgangsfrage. (first)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: Zunächst

Zunächst introduces the first stage and is capitalised here.

Question 3. Gibt es dazu noch ___? (questions)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: Fragen

Fragen invites the audience's questions.

Question 4. Vielen Dank für Ihre ___. (attention)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: Aufmerksamkeit

Aufmerksamkeit is the noun in this formal closing.
